title: Two galaxies nearby
hook: Explore the evidence behind a cosmic question.

knows: Light and gravity help astronomers study the universe.
doesNotKnow: Galaxies can interact and merge under gravity, changing their shapes and redistributing gas and stars. Individual stellar collisions are comparatively unlikely.

misconception: A learner may choose: No: galaxies can never interact
objective: Use the visual model to reason about: Can galaxies merge over cosmic time?

claims.text: Question, correct answer and explanation: Can galaxies merge over cosmic time? Yes: gravity can bring galaxies together and reshape them. Galaxies can interact and merge under gravity, changing their shapes and redistributing gas and stars. Individual stellar collisions are comparatively unlikely.
